title: What's new in Expense Agent: Project Handling (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and overview of Expense Agent project features
Project ledger entries in first release
Project tracking setup and visibility options
Configuration requirements - resources and employee assignments
Web app expense creation and project assignment
Business Central posting and project details review
Assigned resources configuration and project visibility

features.name: Project tracking in Expense Agent web app
features.description: New capability to assign projects to expenses in the web app. Users can enable project tracking through Expense Agent setup and choose between all projects or assigned projects visibility.
caveats: requires project tracking to be enabled in setup
two visibility options must be chosen

features.name: Project visibility options - all projects vs assigned projects
features.description: When enabling project tracking, users can choose to show all projects to all users, or only assigned projects to limit visibility for hundreds of projects or confidential projects.
caveats: choosing assigned projects requires additional configuration
all projects shows everything to all users

features.name: Project resource assignment on project card
features.description: New assigned resources section on the project card allows administrators to select which resources (employees) can see and work with specific projects in the web app.
caveats: requires resources to be created for employees first
can be configured per project or per task

features.name: Project task level resource assignment
features.description: Users can assign resources to specific project task lines, allowing employees to see only the tasks they are assigned to rather than all tasks in a project.
caveats: more granular configuration than project-level assignment

features.name: Resource creation and employee linking prerequisites
features.description: To use project assignment features, administrators must create resources for employees and link them on the employee card by selecting a resource number.
caveats: resource number must be selected on employee card

features.name: Active projects and posting tasks filter
features.description: When viewing projects in the web app, only active projects are shown, and only project tasks that are enabled for posting (excluding beginning and end of period tasks) are available for selection.
caveats: filtering is automatic based on project status
beginning and end of period tasks are filtered out

features.name: Project ledger entry creation on expense posting
features.description: When an expense report with a project assignment is posted, project ledger entries are automatically created in Business Central with the project and project task details.
caveats: only created when expense is posted
requires project and task assignment on expense
